blocks.text: Dr. Vrinda Tokekar (vrindatokekar@yahoo.com, vtokekar@ietdavv.edu.in, (o) 0731-236117, (o) 0731-2761358)
Professor, Department of Information Technology, Institute of Engineering and
Technology (UTD), Devi Ahilya University, Indore, (M.P.) (NAAC ’A+’ Grade)
Head, Information Technology Centre (IT Centre),
Devi Ahilya University, Indore, (M.P.) (NAAC ’A+’ Grade)
Ph.D. (Computer Engineering), 2007, Devi Ahilya University, Indore (M.P.)
M.E. (Computer Engineering), 1992, S.G.S.I.T.S., Indore (M.P.)
B.E. (Hons.) (Electrical and Electronics Engineering), 1984, BITS, Pilani (Raj.)
Area of Specialization
Computer Networks, Wireless and Mobile Ad hoc Network, Information Security,
Software Engineering.
Professional Experience – Thirty Nine Years 8 Months
Teaching:
Post Graduate level (MCA/M.Tech./ M.E.): > Thirty Nine Years (39) years
Under Graduate level (B.E.): Twenty Six (26) Years
Research :
Eleven Candidates awarded Ph.D. degree under my supervision since year 2007. Currently four candidates registered for Ph.D.
Published more than 80 research papers in peer reviewed International Journals and International Conferences. (
Reviewed papers of peer reviewed International Journals and conferences.
Patents : Awarded – 01(US Patent), 2(Indian Patent), Published – 01(Indian)
Administrative: Director, IET, DAVV, (1 year),
Head of Department (25 years). IET, DAVV
Head, IT Center (12 years), DAVV
Serving as member of several committees in the University.
Major Contributions:
Framed University IT Policy in year 2014.

Curriculum Design and Teaching: Actively involved in curriculum design of M.E. /B.E. programs in the capacity of Chairman of board of Studies of Information Technology. Contributed in implementation of Choice Based Credit System in BE and ME programs.

Capacity Planning and Building: Planned, Designed and developed Computer Labs in the department. These activities involved planning and procurement of servers and computers, furniture, power conditioning and networking etc.

Campus Wide Network and Wi-Fi Network Design and Commissioning: Actively involved in Architectural Design, Installation and Commissioning of University level Campus Wide Network infrastructure in two Campuses of University since 1998, also planned and designed controller based Wi-Fi network. The university campus wide network is serving its 10000 users, maintaining webserver, e-mail server, name server, in-house application servers in the campus. The fiber backbone hostel network consist of 1600 nodes spread over 13 hostels.

DAVV-NTPC Foundation ICT Centre: Established ICT center for providing IT training to visually challenged students in collaboration with NTPC Foundation under company’s corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) scheme in 2012.
Roles and Responsibilities :
Chairman Board of Studies of Information Technology in faculty of Engineering. (2013-2015)
Nominated as chairman, Coordinator and member of NAAC Peer team visited in various engineering colleges and other institutions
Nominated as member of NBA team for Accreditation in engineering colleges.

University Coordinator of (i) All India Survey for Higher Education (AISHE) cell since 2010, (ii) DAVV-NTPC Foundation ICT Centre for providing IT training to visually challenged people since 2012 and (iii) Remote Center for conducting online workshops from IITs under NMEICT since 2012.
University Chief Information Security Officer for Cyber security since 2014.
Nominated Member of Advisory Board of affiliated colleges of DAVV University.
Past (Selective):
Nominated as Dean Faculty of Engineering by Hon’ble Governor of Madhya Pradesh in year 2008 (2years).
Member of Executive Council of University in Dean Category during 2009-10.
member of Proctorial board of University (2009-10)
Head Department of Computer Engineering, IET during 2000-2007.
Head Department of Information Technology, IET during 2007-2025.
Examiner for evaluation of Ph.D. thesis from MNIT Jaipur, BITS Pilani Goa and other state and private Universities.
Subject Expert in selection committee for teachers in colleges affiliated to RGPV, Bhopal and other Universities of India.
Member of Academic Committee of MCTE Mhow and Army Cadet College Wing, IMA Dehradun nominated by JNU Delhi (2014-2017).
(Dr. Vrinda Tokekar)
